public_exports.signature: findAndReplace(tree: Nodes, list: FindAndReplaceList | FindAndReplaceTuple, options?: Options | null | undefined): undefined

side_effects: Mutates the supplied tree in place; returns undefined; performs no I/O.
exceptions: A non-array list throws TypeError with the documented message. Errors thrown by user replacement predicates propagate.
inventory_notes: The only runtime export is findAndReplace; helper normalization functions are private.
Function and RegExp inputs require a declarative child-side adapter because they are not JSON values.
The task excludes zero-length RegExp matches to keep the callback boundary bounded and deterministic.
